name: Discord Notify (sandboxed)
description: Tells a Discord channel that an export is done, or that a project is analysed, through a webhook, from AutoScene's sandbox. An example plugin.

exportActions.title: Post to Discord
exportActions.description: Posts the export's name and how many clips it made.

events.title: Post when an analysis finishes
events.description: Posts the project's name and how many episodes were analysed.

settings.title: Webhook URL
settings.description: From the channel's settings: Integrations, Webhooks, Copy Webhook URL. Anyone with it can post to the channel.
